# Security policy

Use GitHub's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/G-aUr-aV/daily-reminders/security/advisories/new) for suspected security issues.

Include the app version or commit, Android version, device model, and the steps needed to reproduce the issue with sample data. Describe which data or permissions are affected. Keep signing credentials, backup passwords, personal reminders, calendar entries, and audio recordings out of reports and attachments.

Reports can cover encrypted backups and restores, access to local files, interaction with Android components and permissions, and access to calendar data. See [Privacy and permissions](../docs/privacy.md) for the app's data model. Use the [bug tracker](https://github.com/G-aUr-aV/daily-reminders/issues) for ordinary functional bugs.
